crossRefs.note: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
translations.bsb: Moses also said to Korah, “Now listen, you sons of Levi!
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
translations.asv: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear now, ye sons of Levi:
